reason: The README clearly defines the plugin as a DSH conversation undo utility, focused on in-place rollback of model-visible chat turns in the current session via `/undo` commands. Its primary function is managing session context, with UI folding behavior for undone turns, so it is best classified under memory-context.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供撤回功能，允许用户在当前会话中通过 `/undo` 指令原地回退最近若干轮对话并继续聊天。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an in-session conversation undo feature for DeepSeek Harness, letting users roll back the last turns with `/undo` commands and continue in the same chat session.

capabilities: Rewinds recent conversation turns in the current session through `/undo` commands
Manipulates model-visible context without creating a new session or forking history
Updates the web UI to collapse expanded undone turns after rollback

reasons.code: The README describes `/undo`/`/undo n`/`/undo all` for undoing the last n completed turns in-place in the current session.
It explicitly states no fork and no new session are used for undo; the same session ID is kept and only visible context is replaced.
The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness session undo utility with command-based operation and no external integration requirements.
